By The Numbers
Questions

FAQ.

What type of videos do you edit?

Short-form, long-form, cinematic and creative content across platforms.

Do you edit both Shorts and long-form?

Yes — I adapt pacing, structure and format to whichever platform the video is for.

How do I send footage?

Google Drive, Dropbox or WeTransfer both work well for raw footage delivery.

How long does editing take?

Turnaround depends on project scope — I'll give you an estimate after reviewing the brief.

How many revisions are included?

This varies by project — details are confirmed before work begins.

What software do you use?

Primarily Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects and DaVinci Resolve.

How can I hire you?

Use the contact form below or email sagarchauhan.exe@gmail.com directly.
